name: Adventure
description: Bold heroes, far places, and narrow escapes.
tone: Energetic, optimistic, and brisk. Danger is real but the heroes are capable. Humor sits comfortably beside peril. Touchstones: pulp serials, swashbucklers, treasure hunts.

narration.style: Keep momentum. Vivid verbs, short paragraphs in action, room to breathe between scenes. End each beat with a choice or a hook.

artStyle: bright painterly illustration, adventure-novel cover, warm light
